items.title: No map of methods choices covering studies since 2019
items.whyItMatters: The survey of 112 studies stops in 2018, before rapid testing and SARS-CoV-2 changed practice.
items.opportunity: Chart studies from 2010 onward with explicit post-2020 items.

items.title: Choices are often unreported
items.whyItMatters: Unreported choices cannot be charted as made.
items.opportunity: Chart 'not reported' as its own category and email authors once.

items.title: Care home residents are rarely reported separately
items.whyItMatters: Older residents carry the most risk and are often excluded.
items.opportunity: Chart inclusion and separate reporting of residents.

items.title: Vaccination source differs between studies
items.whyItMatters: Register and self-report give different estimates.
items.opportunity: Chart the vaccination source and pharmacy capture.

reevaluation: A scoping review with explicit charting of each choice fits the gaps.
summary: Four gaps; the missing post-2018 map is high severity.
